idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. It was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was skipped because it had only been healthy in staging. After the rollback, the service reports healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** after the v2.3.1 deploy, the service was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was newer, but it had only been healthy in staging, so I didn't use it.
- **Result:** all three regions are now on v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure and the rollback, and notes that the cause of the v2.3.1 problem should be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Latest healthy production release is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it doesn't qualify).
